pretreatments.description: Screening: Screened and particles which passed through a 20-mesh sieve and retained by a 40-mesh sieve were collected and stored in a plastic vacuum bag to prevent possible degradation.
Breaking: Broken with a paper cutter to reduce particle size.

Hydrothermal pretreatment at 125, 150, 175, and 200 °C: The hydrothermal pretreatment of Miscanthus was performed in a 100 mL stainless steel reactor with an inserted Teflon vessel. The pretreatment temperature was set at 125, 150, 175 and 200 °C, respectively.
